title: Shen holds motorcade, Chiang touts policies as election nears
summary: Taipei, Nov. 15 (CNA) Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) Taipei mayoral candidate Puma Shen (沈伯洋) held a campaign motorcade Sunday, while incumbent Mayor Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) of the Kuomintang (KMT) highlighted his policy agenda, as the race for the capital's top post entered its final stretch ahead of the Nov. 28…

title: KMT's Lee pledges to build on Hou's record as New Taipei mayor
summary: New Taipei, Nov. 15 (CNA) Kuomintang (KMT) New Taipei mayoral candidate Lee Shu-chuan (李四川) on Sunday pledged to build on incumbent Mayor Hou Yu-ih's (侯友宜) eight-year record as the two campaigned together in Sanchong District ahead of the Nov. 28 local elections.

title: Academia Sinica head Chen Chien-jen receives NTU Distinguished Alumni Award
summary: Taipei, Nov. 15 (CNA) Academia Sinica President Chen Chien-jen (陳建仁), who helped strengthen Taiwan's disease-control system following the 2003 SARS outbreak, received National Taiwan University's (NTU) Distinguished Alumni Award on Sunday.

Referendum reignites debate over Taiwan's 'non-nuclear homeland' policy
summary: Taipei, Nov. 14 (CNA) A supporter of ending Taiwan's "non-nuclear homeland" policy argued Saturday that restarting reactors could buy time for renewable energy to develop, while a government representative questioned the need for a referendum when restart assessments were already underway under existing law.

title: Chiang, Shen ramp up campaigns ahead of local elections
summary: Taipei, Nov. 14 (CNA) Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) and his Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) challenger Puma Shen (沈伯洋) stepped up their campaigns Saturday, with Chiang staging a large-scale rally and march and Shen organizing a music festival ahead of Nov. 28's local elections.

title: KMT, DPP candidates for Kaohsi0ung mayor court voters at TV forum
summary: Taipei, Nov. 14 (CNA) The Kuomintang (KMT) and Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) candidates for Kaohsiung mayor clashed over city funding at a televised policy forum Saturday, even as both pledged to carry on parts of outgoing Mayor Chen Chi-mai's (陳其邁) agenda.

title: 5 allies back Taiwan's participation at COP31: MOFA
summary: Taipei, Nov. 14 (CNA) Five of Taiwan's diplomatic allies have voiced support for its participation in global climate efforts at the 31st Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP31), the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said Saturday.

title: The activities of the CCP’s 21-machine warship around the Taiwan Strait are closely monitored by the national military and should be dealt with
title_original: 中共21機艦船台海周邊活動 國軍嚴密監控應處
summary: （中央社記者吳書緯台北14日電）國防部表示，自昨天上午6時至今天上午6時，偵獲共機10架次，其中4架次逾越中線進入中部、西南及東部空域，以及8艘共艦及3艘公務船，總計中共21機艦船持續在台海周邊活動，國軍嚴密監控與應處。
